(Japanese: 勝ち残った４人 The Remaining Four) is the 30th chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
Ryouga ends up in the location where all of the other defeated players were sent to by Pauline.
Pauline sends her Pokémon to retrieve Ryouga so they can start the next round on the next day.
